The '''Tyberious system''' was a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Tyberious Institute of Xenobiology]].<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tyberious [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA" />
